faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about TrendVaulta, shipping, payments, and support

whatIs.a: TrendVaulta is a premium retail store for beauty, fashion, and lifestyle products from curated brands — with secure checkout and tracked delivery.

howToPurchase.q: How do I purchase a product?
howToPurchase.a: Simply browse our products, select your preferred size and color, and click the "Add to Cart" button. You can then proceed to checkout and complete your purchase securely.

canReturn.a: Yes! We offer a 30-day return policy for most products. Items must be unworn, unwashed, and in original packaging with tags attached.

shippingMethods.q: What shipping methods do you offer?
shippingMethods.a: We offer standard shipping (5-7 business days) and express shipping (2-3 business days). Shipping costs are calculated based on weight and destination.

international.a: Yes, we ship to most countries worldwide. International shipping times and costs vary by destination.

trackOrder.q: How can I track my order?
trackOrder.a: Once your order ships, you will receive a tracking number via email. You can track your order status in your account dashboard.

paymentMethods.q: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.a: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and bank transfers for enterprise purchases.

refundPolicy.a: We offer a 30-day refund policy for most products. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days of receiving the returned item.

securePayments.a: Yes, all payments are processed through Stripe, which is PCI DSS compliant and uses industry-standard encryption.

orderSupport.q: How do I get support for my order?
orderSupport.a: You can contact our support team through the contact page or by emailing support@trendvaulta.com. We typically respond within 24 hours.

customOrders.a: We don't offer custom orders directly, but we regularly update our inventory with new products and limited editions.

damagedItem.q: How do I report a damaged or incorrect item?
damagedItem.a: If you receive a damaged or incorrect item, please contact our support team immediately with photos of the item and packaging. We'll arrange a replacement or refund.

shipping.question: How long does shipping usually take?
shipping.answer: Most orders dispatch within 1–2 business days. Standard delivery is typically 5–7 business days; express options appear at checkout when available.

returns.question: Can I return this item?
returns.answer: Eligible unused items can usually be returned within 30 days in original packaging. See our returns policy for hygiene-sealed exceptions.

payments.question: Is checkout secure?
payments.answer: Yes. Payments are processed through encrypted, Stripe-secured checkout. TrendVaulta never stores full card numbers.

sensitiveSkin.question: Is this suitable for sensitive skin?
sensitiveSkin.answer: Always check the ingredient list on the product page. If you have sensitivities, patch-test first or ask our care team before full use.

storage.question: How should I store this product?
storage.answer: Keep in a cool, dry place away from direct sun. Close lids tightly after use to protect texture and scent.

routine.question: When should I use this in my routine?
routine.answer: Most cleansers go first, then treatments/serums, then moisturizer and SPF by day. Follow any usage notes on the packaging.

shade.question: How do I choose the right shade?
shade.answer: Compare undertone (cool/warm/neutral) in natural light. If you are between shades, the lighter option is often easier to correct.

sizing.question: How does sizing run?
sizing.answer: Check the size guide and measurements on the product page when listed. If you prefer a relaxed fit, consider sizing up.

fashionCare.question: How do I care for this piece?
fashionCare.answer: Follow the care label. Many items prefer gentle wash or cool water; avoid high heat drying unless the label allows it.

shrink.question: Will this shrink after washing?
shrink.answer: Follow the garment care label. Natural fibers can relax or shrink with heat — cool wash and air dry when recommended.

readyToUse.question: Is this ready to use out of the box?
readyToUse.answer: Most lifestyle pieces arrive ready for everyday use. Any assembly or care notes will be listed under product details when required.

placement.question: Where does this work best at home?
placement.answer: Use on a stable, dry surface unless the listing says otherwise. Keep away from prolonged moisture if the material is not waterproof.

s1.heading: 1. Information We Collect
s1.p1: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, make a purchase, or contact us for support. This may include your name, email address, payment information, and any other information you choose to provide.
s1.p2: We also collect information automatically when you use our service, including your IP address, browser type, device information, and usage patterns.

s2.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
s2.p1: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, process transactions, send you technical notices and support messages, and respond to your comments and questions.
s2.p2: We may also use your information to send you marketing communications about our products and services, if you have consented to receive such communications.

s3.heading: 3. Information Sharing
s3.p1: We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to third parties without your consent, except as described in this policy or as required by law.
s3.p2: We may share your information with service providers who perform services on our behalf, such as payment processing, data analysis, and email delivery. These providers are contractually obligated to protect your information.

s4.heading: 4. Data Security
s4.p1: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
s4.p2: However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security of your information.

s5.heading: 5. Cookies and Tracking
s5.p1: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to collect and track information about your activity on our service. Cookies are files with small amounts of data which may include an anonymous unique identifier.
s5.p2: You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, if you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use some portions of our service.

s6.heading: 6. Your Rights
s6.p1: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. You may also opt out of marketing communications at any time.
s6.p2: To exercise these rights, please contact us at support@trendvaulta.com with your request.

s7.heading: 7. Children's Privacy
s7.p1: Our service is not intended for children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we become aware that we have collected such information, we will take steps to delete it.

s8.heading: 8. Changes to This Policy
s8.p1: We may update our privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.

s9.heading: 9. Contact Information
s9.p1: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at support@trendvaulta.com

s2.p2: TrendVaulta reserves the right to refuse or suspend access to the website for any user when necessary to protect the store or other customers.

s3.heading: 3. Products & Orders

s3.p2: Placing an order constitutes an offer to purchase. We may cancel or refuse an order if an item is unavailable, mispriced, or suspected of fraud.

s4.heading: 4. Payment Terms

s4.p2: Prices may change without notice for future orders. Coupons and promotions are subject to their stated conditions and may be withdrawn at any time.

s5.heading: 5. Shipping, Returns & Refunds

s5.p2: Eligible returns follow our store return policy (typically within the stated window, unused and in original condition). Refunds are processed to the original payment method after we receive and inspect the return, except where local law requires otherwise.

s6.heading: 6. Intellectual Property

s6.p2: Brand names and product imagery belonging to third parties remain the property of those brands. You may not copy or reuse store content for commercial purposes without permission.

s7.heading: 7. User Conduct

s7.p2: You may not upload, post, or otherwise transmit any content that is infringing, libelous, defamatory, obscene, or otherwise objectionable — including abusive reviews or fraudulent claims.
